public_rationale: The blanket denial fails for AI 2027. Its [methods](https://ai-2027.com/research/timelines-forecast) explicitly draw on measured model task performance. [METR's underlying study](https://metr.org/blog/2025-03-19-measuring-ai-ability-to-complete-long-tasks/) reports both capability gains and serious limitations. That is an empirical basis, although it does not prove the forecast. This outcome does not endorse every named story or settle the unidentified GPT-4 reference.
limitations: The decisive finding concerns AI 2027's foundation, not every article discussing it.
Demonstrated task capabilities do not establish economy-wide job displacement.
The blackmail demonstration involved Claude and fictional circumstances; it is context only.

evidence.explanation: AI 2027's underlying analysis explicitly starts from measured task-completion capabilities and extrapolates them. This contradicts the blanket absence-of-capability-basis claim without validating the extrapolation.

The underlying study measures success on software and reasoning tasks and finds increasing task horizons, while explicitly warning that agents cannot reliably replace workers in broader roles. Its measured trend supplies a basis; its limitations support caution about sweeping extrapolations.
